title: Graphics & UI/UX Designer
description:
About the job

Job Description

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphics & UI/UX Designer to shape how European IT Institute looks and feels, from our brand and marketing materials to the websites, platforms, and digital tools our students use every day. You will work closely with our marketing, web development, and academic teams to turn ideas into polished, user-friendly designs.




Key Responsibilities

Graphic design

Create marketing and brand assets: social media graphics, banners, brochures, posters, presentations, email templates, and event materials.
Maintain and evolve the Institute's visual identity and brand guidelines
Produce course promotional materials, certificates, and campaign visuals

UI/UX design

Research user needs and translate them into wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
Design and improve the website, landing pages, student portal, and learning platform interfaces
Build and maintain a consistent design system and component library
Run usability tests and use feedback and analytics to improve designs
Hand off well-organized specs and assets to developers, and review the implementation

Collaboration

Work with marketing, development, admissions, and faculty to meet project goals and deadlines
Present design concepts and rationale clearly to stakeholders
Keep up with design trends, accessibility standards, and best practices




Additional Requirements

Strong portfolio showing both visual design and product/UX work
Proficiency in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD) and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
Solid understanding of typography, layout, color theory, and responsive design
Knowledge of UX methods: user research, information architecture, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing
Preferred degrees are Bachelor in any discipline.
Experience must be within 2-4 years.




Skills & Area of Expertise

Figma
Adobe Creative Suite
Photoshop
Illustrator




Compensation and Benefits

Mobile Bill Allowance
Sick Leave
Casual Leave
Salary review: Yearly
Festival bonus: 2 bonus
Lunch benefit: Full subsidize

Our client is looking for a UI/UX & CRO Specialist who can combine strong design instincts with a conversion-focused mindset. This person will be responsible for improving websites, landing pages, and user journeys from both a UX and conversion perspective. The ideal candidate can identify where users are experiencing friction, translate those insights into strong design solutions, and develop CRO tests to measure whether those changes actually improve performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from “here’s the problem” → “here’s the design solution” → “here’s the conversion hypothesis” → “here’s how we test it.”

title: Officer, UI/UX Designing (For A Private Commercial Bank) - Job ID : 1534920
description:
About the job

A Private Commercial Bank is looking for Officer, UI/UX Designing




Job Description / Responsibility

Job Purpose

To design intuitive, customer-centric user interfaces and experiences for the Bank's digital banking products, ensuring designs align with brand guidelines, usability best practices, and evolving customer needs.

Functional Responsibilities

UI/UX Design & Product Experience: Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs for digital banking products, websites, and mobile applications. Support the end-to-end design process from concept through final handoff for development.
User Research & Experience Insights: Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer journey mapping to inform design decisions and improve customer experience. Test and iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, usability findings, and A/B testing results.
Design Governance & Consistency: Ensure design consistency and adherence to the Bank’s guidelines, accessibility standards, and approved design system. Create and maintain design assets, style guides, component libraries, and reusable UI patterns for digital products.
Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Stay updated on UI/UX design trends, tools, technologies, and best practices within digital banking and fintech. Recommend design improvements and innovative user experience solutions to enhance product usability, engagement, and digital adoption.

Educational Requirements

Bachelor/Honors

Experience Requirements

1 to 5 year(s)

Banks
